children: Apple Inc. (AAPL, Financials) is preparing one of its biggest changes to the iPhone in years. China's smartphone makers are not waiting around for it.
Huawei and Xiaomi are pushing new premium devices as Apple approaches the expected debut of its first foldable iPhone. That makes China an especially important test.

Apple does not get the advantage of introducing an entirely new category there. Huawei already has experience selling foldable phones, while Chinese brands have become increasingly competitive at the expensive end of the market.
Apple still has something rivals want: millions of loyal iPhone customers. The question is how many will pay what is expected to be a premium price for a foldable model.
China makes that question even more important as Apple tries to protect its position against stronger domestic brands. Apple's upcoming product event should provide the next clue.
If the foldable arrives as expected, investors will quickly find out whether Apple can turn a new form factor into another meaningful iPhone upgrade cycle.

title: Apple's Foldable iPhone Is About to Face a China Problem
